scripts.build: npm run generate:runtime-assets && npm run check:i18n-content && tsc && vite build
scripts.build:poki: npm run generate:runtime-assets && npm run check:i18n-content && tsc && vite build --mode poki
scripts.build:crazygames: npm run generate:runtime-assets && npm run check:i18n-content && tsc && vite build --mode crazygames
scripts.package:poki: npm run build:poki && node scripts/package-platform.mjs poki
scripts.package:crazygames: npm run build:crazygames && node scripts/package-platform.mjs crazygames
